title: Exposure Integrity Engine
purpose: Turn public records, allegations, rumours, speculation, entity relationships and power mechanisms into a user-friendly investigative system without presenting proximity, repetition or inference as proof.

fact_adjudicated.label: Adjudicated fact
fact_adjudicated.rule: Final criminal judgment, final civil finding, authenticated court order or equivalent adjudicated record supports the exact statement.

fact_official_record.label: Documented official record
fact_official_record.rule: An official filing, regulator record, contract, registry, transcript, legislation, audit or authenticated primary record supports the exact statement.

fact_corroborated.label: Corroborated documented fact
fact_corroborated.rule: Multiple independent reliable sources support the same bounded statement where the primary record is unavailable or incomplete.

official_allegation.label: Official allegation
official_allegation.rule: A charge, indictment, complaint, official investigation or named legal filing makes the allegation. It is not a finding of guilt.

attributed_allegation.label: Attributed allegation
attributed_allegation.rule: A named person, report or publication makes the allegation and the origin is traceable. It is not established fact.

documented_association.label: Documented association
documented_association.rule: A meeting, message, payment, appointment, trip, photograph, membership or other contact is documented. Association alone does not establish knowledge, coordination or wrongdoing.

analytical_inference.label: Analytical inference
analytical_inference.rule: A stated reasoning chain connects documented facts, with alternatives, counter-evidence and falsifiers shown.

rumour.label: Rumour
rumour.rule: A circulating claim has a traceable origin but insufficient evidence. Repetition does not upgrade it.

speculation.label: Speculation
speculation.rule: A hypothesis or possibility is explored without enough evidence to call it fact.

unsupported_or_debunked.label: Unsupported, contradicted or debunked
unsupported_or_debunked.rule: The claim lacks a reliable evidence chain, conflicts with stronger evidence or has been materially disproved.

sensitiveClaimRules: Child abuse, trafficking, sexual offences, homicide and other serious criminal claims about a named person must display the exact legal or evidence lane before the allegation text.
No automated system may upgrade a named criminal allegation to fact from association, keyword overlap, source volume or network proximity.
Convictions, charges, investigations, civil findings, attributed allegations, rumours and speculation must remain visually and structurally separate.
Victim identities and identifying details about children are omitted by default.
Illegal material is never accepted, stored, linked or reproduced.
Acquittals, dismissals, reversals, denials, corrections and right of reply remain attached to the relevant record.
hitListBoundary: The Hit List is an investigative-priority and navigation surface, not a threat list, guilt ranking or call for harassment. Inclusion means the entity has documented power relevance, an evidence-backed accountability record, a significant unresolved evidence gap or a clearly labelled public claim requiring investigation.
timerRules: A timer moves only when dated evidence matches the timer's published raise or lower rule.
A rumour, speculation card or unsupported graph edge may create a research route but cannot move a timer by itself.
Every timer movement must retain the source route, prior score, new score, reason, counter-signal and date.
dossierRules: Every dossier should display documented facts before allegations or speculation.
Every material claim should show what supports it, what it does not prove, counter-evidence, missing records and what would change the conclusion.
No-match panels mean no approved record is currently mapped; they are not clearance or exoneration.
New evidence must update the existing entity record rather than create disconnected duplicate profiles.

forbiddenAutonomousUpgrades: infer criminal conduct from religion, ethnicity, surname, symbolism or social proximity
change a timer without a dated source-linked trigger

userExperienceRules: Lead with a short plain-English conclusion.
Use visible labels and avoid unexplained evidence codes.
Every priority card must link to a dossier, timer, source or missing-record action.
Mobile and keyboard navigation must remain usable.
Empty states must explain what is missing and what the reader can do next.
